rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Rent Coordination
rules.requirement: Owners of residential buildings with six or more units may not use software or services that use nonpublic competitor data to set rents or occupancy levels. Violations are fined $300 per unit per day.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent coordination services using nonpublic competitor data; 6+ unit buildings; $300 per unit per day
rules.quoted_span: No owner of a residential building containing six or more dwelling units in the City of Cambridge shall use an algorithmic rent coordination service to set rents or occupancy levels for any dwelling unit in such building.
rules.effective_date_note: Section 8.80.040 states it takes effect March 1, 2027; future effective date relative to the 2026-10-01 query date.
rules.penalty: $300 per unit per day; each day is a separate offense
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential buildings with six or more dwelling units in Cambridge.
rules.conflict_note: Document is labeled a test fixture / fictional; treat with caution.

parsed.doc_summary: Ordinance No. 2026-99 (labeled a fictional test fixture) would add Cambridge Mun. Code ch. 8.80 banning use of algorithmic rent coordination services using nonpublic competitor data in 6+ unit buildings, with $300 per unit per day fines. It was adopted 2026-09-14 and takes effect 2027-03-01.
